description: Rights-based monthly financial assistance scheme for female heads of eligible families in Tamil Nadu.
benefits: ₹1,000 per month financial grant deposited directly into bank accounts.

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must be a female head of family
eligibility_rules.source: G.O. (Ms) No. 49, Special Programme Implementation Department, TN

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must be at least 21 years of age
Annual family income must not exceed ₹2,50,000
eligibility_rules.source: G.O. (Ms) No. 49, Section 4(i), Special Programme Implementation Dept

eligibility_rules.description: Annual household electricity consumption must be under 3,600 units
Family land holding must be less than 5 acres of wet land OR less than 10 acres of dry land
Family must not own a four-wheeler (car, jeep, or light motor vehicle)

required_documents: Tamil Nadu Smart Family Card (Ration Card)
application_method: Special application camps organized at local e-Sevai centers and ward/village offices across Tamil Nadu.
source_document: G.O. (Ms) No. 49 Special Programme Implementation Dept, Govt of Tamil Nadu
